service.method: SELECT CODE ,TEXT5 FROM SCODE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = '000' AND TYPE = 'ECT002' AND LANGUAGE = 'KO' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , DOC_NUMBER , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , POSTPROCESSED , POSTPROCESSED_RESULT , ATTACH_NUMBER , CHANGE_USER_ID , PRC_TYPE , DATA FROM SMCWT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND DOC_NUMBER = $S{DOC_NUMBER} AND POSTPROCESSED = $S{POSTPROCESSED} AND PRC_TYPE IN ($INS{PRC_TYPE})

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , BIZ_CODE , BIZ_CATEGORY , BIZ_TYPE , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , SELLER_NAME_LOC , IRS_NO , ZIP_CODE , ADDRESS_LOC , PHONE_NO , EMAIL , CEO_NAME_LOC , FOUNDATION_DATE , IF_FLAG FROM SBUPR WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND IRS_NO = $S{IRS_NO }

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , BIZ_CODE , SEQ , USER_ID , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , USER_NAME , EMAIL , PHONE_NO , IF_FLAG FROM SBUPI WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BIZ_CODE = ${BIZ_CODE} AND USER_ID = ${USER_ID} AND DEL_FLAG = 'N'

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , CONT_NO , CONT_GL_SEQ , SIGNER_NO , SEQ , SIGNER_ID , SIGNER_NAME , SIGNER_EMAIL , SIGNER_PHONE , SIGNER_COMPANY_CODE , SIGNER_COMPANY_NAME , SIGNER_COMPANY_OWNER , SIGNER_COMPANY_ADDR , SIGN_FLAG , SIGN_TYPE , SIGN_KEY , SIGN_VALUE , SIGN_FIX_HTML , LINK FROM SSIGN WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CONT_NO = ${CONT_NO} AND DEL_FLAG = 'N'

SELECT DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC, DEPT.DEPT_NAME_ENG, ( SELECT TEXT1 FROM SCODE CODE WHERE CODE.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CODE.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} AND CODE.TYPE = 'UX049' AND CODE.CODE = USMT.POSITION ) AS POSITION, USMT.USER_ID FROM SUSMT USMT LEFT OUTER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.DEPT = DEPT.DEPT WHERE USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND USER_ID IN ($INS{USER_ID_LIST})
